simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שׁוֹא (H7722) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 13 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שׁוֹא (shôwʼ) means a tempest ; by implication, devastation First listed occurrence: Ezek 38 9.

definitions.full: H7722. sho [ שׁוֺא ] noun [masculine] ravage (?); — plural suffix שֹׁאֵיהֶם Psa 35:17 rescue me from their ravages (si vera lectio); ᵐ5 κακουργία ; Ol Dy Gr Che Comm. plausibly שַׁאֲגָם their roaring , compare 35:16 ; 35:17 c; We Du שֹׁאֲגִים . שֹׁאָה שׁוֺאָה, noun feminine devastation, ruin, waste ; — absolute ׳שׁו Isa 10:3 +, שֹׁאָה 47:11 ; Zeph 1:15 ; Job 30:14 (+ 38:27 van d. H. Gi, but see Baer's note); construct שֹׁאַת Prov 3:25 ; — 1 devastation, ruin , as coming on person, Isa 10:3 ; 47:11 (Babylon personified), Psa 35:8 ; a 63:10 ; רְשָׁעִים שֹׁאַת Prov 3:25 (object Genitive; || מַּחַד ); ׳(יוֺם)שׁ וּמְשׁוֺאָה Zeph 1:15 ; probably = devastating storm , in simile Ezek 38:9 (|| עָנָן ), Prov 1:27 (Qr; Kt שׁאוה ; || סוּפָה ). — Psa 35:8 b read probably שַׁחְתֹּה his pit , ᵑ6 We (compare 35:7 ). 2 concretely , ruin, waste , of the desert, Job 30:3 (reading אֶרֶץ for אֶמֶשׁ Ol; otherwise below 1 ), ׳שׁ וּמְשׁוֺאָה Job 38:27 (|| מִדְבָּר 38:26 ); = ruins 30:14 .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) שׁוֹאָה ; or שֹׁאָה ; from an unused root meaning to rush over;
